question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Gift of the gab

options.text: A gift for a person named Gab

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Gift of the gab"** refers to the ability to speak easily and confidently in a way that makes people want to listen to you and believe you. (बात करने की प्रतिभा)

 
 
• **Example: **He has the** gift of the gab,** making him an excellent salesperson.
 
 
 
• **"A talent for speaking"** means having the ability to talk in such a way that people enjoy listening to you or are persuaded by what you say. (बात करने की कला)
 
 
• **Example: **She used her talent for speaking to convince the committee of her ideas.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate meaning of **'Gift of the gab'** is **'A talent for speaking'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A gift for a person named Gab** (गैब नाम के व्यक्ति के लिए एक उपहार): This is a literal interpretation and does not capture the idiomatic meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** This is not the intended meaning of the idiom.
 
 
 
• **A talent for lying **(झूठ बोलने की कला): The ability to lie convincingly.
 
 
• **Example: **Despite his talent for lying, people eventually found out the truth.
 
 
 
• **A talent for singing** (गाने की कला): The ability to sing well.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a talent for singing and has won many competitions.
 
 

3c:T6be,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
